summary: Lincoln County, OR summit: crow's nest 1933, CCC-built 53-ft pole tower 1939; destroyed in a 1951 windstorm; a laddered tree from the crow's nest remains.

facts.design: 53-foot pole tower of the register's L-4 type, with a garage, built by the CCC in 1939; crow's nest lookout added 1933
facts.status_note: Destroyed in a 1951 windstorm per the register and firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts gives only the word 'Removed' with no date; a laddered tree from the crow's nest remains

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The brief records firelookout.com as standing. The page as read on 2026-10-09 says the tower was destroyed in a 1951 windstorm, so the record is kept as gone.

The register and firelookout.com say a 1951 windstorm destroyed the tower. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the word 'Removed' with no date. The story reports the windstorm and notes the one-word entry.

notes_for_editor: The height_m 16.2 in the brief matches the 53-ft tower in the Forest Lookouts CCC record, so it is kept. Access is not stated in any source and is left out. The brief's firelookout_com=standing conflict does not match the page as read today. The register gives a 1951 windstorm and the Forest Lookouts history says only 'Removed'; the story reports both. No photos with image URLs were extracted (the register credits a photo to Danielle Sulivan, but no image URL was found). Newspaper and Forest Service archive searches were not run.
